title: Assessing model calibration with boosting trees
abstract: arXiv:2606.08084v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The main goal in regression modelling consists in approximating the conditional mean of a response given a set of features. A regression function is said to be strongly calibrated if the resulting mean estimates match the true conditional means for almost every set of features. Aiming for strong calibration seems not achievable in practice as one typically deals with finite samples of noisy observations. A weaker notion of calibration is auto-calibration, and it means that the conditional expectation of the response, given a mean estimate, matches this estimate. This notion is important, e.g., in insurance pricing as it ensures no cross-subsidization between different price cohorts. In this paper, we show that boosting trees can be used to test necessary conditions for strong calibration and auto-calibration, respectively. translated_title: 使用提升树评估模型校准
translated_abstract: 回归建模的主要目标是在给定一组特征的情况下近似响应变量的条件均值。如果回归函数所得到的均值估计对于几乎每一组特征都与真实的条件均值相匹配，则称该回归函数是强校准的。由于实践中通常处理的是带有噪声的有限样本观测，追求强校准似乎无法实现。一个较弱的校准概念是自校准，它意味着在给定均值估计的条件下，响应变量的条件期望与该估计相匹配。这一概念非常重要，例如在保险定价中，它确保不同价格群体之间不存在交叉补贴。在本文中，我们证明提升树可用于分别检验强校准和自校准的必要条件。我们方法的实际相关性得到了一个数值例子的支持，其中所提出的检验...
tldr: 本文提出利用提升树来检验回归模型强校准和自校准的必要条件，并以保险定价等场景中的数值实验验证了该方法的实际应用价值。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that boosting trees can be used to test necessary conditions for strong calibration and auto-calibration in regression models, with practical relevance demonstrated through numerical examples such as insurance pricing.
